title: Days of Our Lives Spoilers, Thursday, July 30: Rachel Comes Home While Joy Needs a Reality Check… - NewsBreak
text:
By Jamie White ,
5 hours ago Days of Our Lives spoilers for Thursday, July 30 reveal Rachel Black ( Lorelei Mote ) gets her wish. Meanwhile, Alex Kiriakis ( Robert Scott Wilson ) takes a stand. Plus, Joy Wesley ( AlexAnn Hopkins ) gets advice. Here’s what you need to know.
Key Highlights Rachel finally comes home. Alex refuses to give in to Joy. Joy looks to an interesting source for help.
She’s home! First, the Blacks celebrate Rachel’s release from Bayview. Days of Our Lives spoilers reveal it’s been a long time coming, and she frankly shouldn’t have been at Bayview specifically at all. However, she finally got her wish and her family will make sure her welcome home is a big event. We’re sure of at least three people that will likely be there, one being her father. Plus, her brother and grandmother. We’d like to say Kristen DiMera ( Stacy Haiduk ) will be there as well, but that’s still up in the air. The weekly shows her getting abducted this week, and there’s only two days to go. So, she could theoretically be snatched before she gets the chance to celebrate with Rachel.
No worries Elsewhere, there was major drama regarding the baby when Alex tried to finalize the details with Joy. She is dead set against ever letting Stephanie Johnson ( Abigail Klein ) near that baby, even if something happens to her and Alex would be her only living parent. It’s a tough situation to be in.
However, Alex steps up for his wife, as he assures Stephanie he won’t agree to Joy’s terms. We do believe Joy is right to have concerns about Stephanie. But we also think it’s basically impossible for Alex to be married to Stephanie and never have her come anywhere near his daughter until she’s 18 and can do what she wants. So, we think she does needs to take a step back and think about the long-term. We think it’d be enough for Stephanie getting counseling, not owning a gun (which she willingly gave back to her father), and maybe even be supervised when with the baby until some time’s gone by. But this current stance is not sustainable and if Joy is smart, she’ll admit that and find the compromise.
Seeking help Finally, Days of Our Lives spoilers reveal Joy is obviously not happy Alex isn’t agreeable. So, she’ll consult Belle Black ( Martha Madison ) for legal advice. We have a feeling this is a losing proposition for her. We truly believe Belle understands what happened and why and didn’t see a reason to pursue charges. So, we doubt she’ll be supportive of keeping this Stephanie ban in place forever. We’ll see if she pulls out any old dramas of her own to try to make Joy see the light.
